summary: Support a governed first seed commit and explicit Paxlet product placement

delivery.outcome: Provide an explicit managed first-governance-seed transaction for an unborn native adopter, preserving source/remote boundaries, and represent the explicitly requested paxlet-com product placement. Independently publish the standard fix so Shellmux can continue through ordinary allocation.
nonGoals: No product source or remote effect in the seed commit
No hook bypass or generic commit-tree fallback
No changes to protected merge authority or foreign work
No Shellmux source or target evidence stored in this maintenance ticket

architecture.decision: The managed allocator reserves the first ID under its existing clone lock. An explicit external exact-state seed request validates published adoption pins, a concrete seed-only allowlist, owner/session, no existing HEAD/ref/remote/implementation, secret scan and staged/worktree equality. The managed hook recognizes only that prepared transaction before the normal ticket/worktree guard. It creates one ordinary checked Git commit, then the allocator creates the canonical linked delivery checkout and ordinary lease from the real baseline. Normal source and publication checks are unchanged. Add paxlet-com to the closed placement vocabulary while retaining wellmanifest runtime rejection.
interfaceChanges: Explicit allocator seed request and seed hook validation
paxlet-com product placement in the closed HOME/runtimeOwner vocabulary
dataChanges: Ignored bounded seed transaction request/receipt; actual baseline SHA only
architecture.rollback: Revert the independently reviewed material standard change; preserve any already created valid seed baseline and its external receipt.

validation.evidence: Local PASS: 8 seed/placement regressions, 20 canonical allocation regressions, 18 immutable adoption regressions; active normal pre-commit/commit-message hooks exercised. Secret, product, ignored product, stale request/pin, owner, symlink, remote and repeated-seed refusals passed.

Local GOV-PASS, no errors/warnings; explicit paxlet-com accepted and wellmanifest runtime guard preserved. Host boundaries passed (7 commit-message + 9 pre-push regressions). Protected local preflight resolved configuration; exact-head independent CI/review/merge and immutable release remain pending.
